methodology_note: Reference baseline established by 1 run of the Kiro CLI agent (Auto model) with the skill loaded, graded against the Must/Should rubric in each test case. Input token footprint measured with tiktoken (cl100k_base). Consumers SHOULD re-run in their own environment across their target models (3 runs each) and record their own scores/tokens/latency below — a baseline is only meaningful relative to a specific model + harness + skill-version combination.
